description: List who a coupon was offered to and what they did with it: per-address status (invited / redeemed / revoked), where the invite came from, and the timestamps. Also returns the coupon's own `invite_only` flag -- read that FIRST: when it is false the invite rows are recorded but NOT enforced, and anyone holding the code can still redeem it. Read-only. Use list_coupons for the coupon's terms, invite_to_coupon to add addresses, revoke_coupon_invite to withdraw one.
name: list_coupon_invites
